subject: prd/tech-design-review
statement: When a round completes, the reviewer shall record exactly one verdict — approve · approve-with-advisories · request-changes · escalate — request-changes requiring ≥ 1 blocking finding, and the report (findings, dispositions, rounds, verdict history, measurements) shall ride the design's introducing PR as its evidence package.
fit_criterion: one verdict per run; schema-valid reports; the package present in the e2e demo
